changelog: The app's whole TV section could disappear, and this is why. Jellyfin's own library lookup throws an error when it is handed an empty id instead of answering "no such item" - and half of what a channel schedules has no library item behind it at all: an advert is an address, a trailer is an address, and a break that is not announcing anything has no programme to name. One of those on air was enough to make the request that lists channels fail outright. The app reads a failure there as "this server does not have the plugin" and quietly takes TV out of its menu, so the channels vanished with nothing anywhere saying why - and whether it happened depended entirely on what happened to be airing at the moment somebody opened the app, which is why it looked random. Every library lookup in the plugin now treats an empty id as nothing rather than as a question, in one place that all of them go through; seventeen of them were unguarded. Caught by opening the app on an emulator and finding no TV section at all, then reading the server's log rather than the app's.
description: Lightweight virtual TV channels: deterministic schedules over your own library, tuned in via normal direct playback at the live position. No transcoding, no tuner emulation.
name: LiteTV Channels
overview: TV channels from your library, without transcoding.
